name: run-it
title: Run It Yourself
html:
Run It Yourself

Walk once (tokens) 
exhibits/merge-watch-release/capture-release.sh 501

A model key and Jenkins. Writes release.heart.yaml and release.pins.yaml. The kit already ships both, so this step is optional.

Replay (zero tokens) · only Docker 
kit/release.sh up              # the parties and Jenkins
kit/release.sh run github      # five releases, a small GitHub in the kit
kit/release.sh up gitlab       # and GitLab too (about 4 GB)
kit/release.sh run gitlab      # the same five, at GitLab
kit/release.sh run github-live # at OWNER/REPO on real GitHub
kit/release.sh down

Each release’s trace lands in work/runs/<scm>/pr-N.yaml.
say: Two different things to run. The walk, once, needs a model key and Jenkins, and keeps the script and its pins; the kit already ships them, so you can skip it. The replay is the kit: bring it up, then run the five releases at a small GitHub inside the kit, at GitLab in a container, or at your own repository on real GitHub. Only Docker is needed. Notice that GitLab gets no script of its own: it runs the same one.
